packs.why: Pack 0.4.0: players move in Fresh Animations' style (Entity Model Features). Turned on once; switched off under Options, Resource Packs, it stays off.
Pack 0.4.0: animated mobs (Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features). Below its Player Extension, which is made to sit on top of it.
Pack 0.4.0: blanks the anti-resale notice Yuushya Townscape sends every player on every join (its declaration.* lines). Our own pack, above the mods' resources.

keys.name: justzoom.keybinds.keybind.zoom
keys.why: Z is also Effortless Building's undo (Ctrl+Z) and Xaero's minimap zoom. Not C (RLCraft Plus's pick): in creative, C held with 1-9 saves the hotbar. V has only the F3+V debug combination.

keys.name: justzoom.keybinds.keybind.open_options
keys.why: B is Xaero's new waypoint; Just Zoom's settings stay in Mod Menu (RLCraft Plus unbinds it too).

keys.name: gui.xaero_open_map
keys.why: M is Litematica's main menu. J was free.

keys.name: gui.xaero_minimap_settings
keys.why: Y is Effortless Building's redo (Ctrl+Y); the minimap settings stay in Mod Menu.

keys.name: gui.xaero_instant_waypoint
keys.why: Keypad + opens Effortless Building's modifiers screen; B still makes a waypoint.

keys.name: iris.keybind.shaderPackSelection
keys.why: I is Litematica's info overlay; shader packs stay in Video Settings, and K still turns shaders on and off.

keys.name: axiom.keybind.context
keys.why: Left Alt is Effortless Building's radial menu (in the pack since 0.3.3). The ` key was free.
